name: Marco Samson
about: I build web applications that turn everyday tasks into clear, usable experiences. My projects explore classroom learning, project management, and local commerce, with a focus on organizing information and making each step easier to follow.

projects.title: QuizWeb
projects.description: A classroom quiz platform that brings teaching and learning into one space. Teachers can manage classes, prepare AI-assisted quizzes, review submissions, and communicate with students. Learners have a dedicated dashboard to access quizzes and follow their classroom activity.

images.caption: A welcoming sign-in screen introduces Chalk, the classroom quiz space.
The teacher dashboard brings classroom activity and quiz management together.
AI-assisted quiz creation helps teachers prepare classroom assessments.
The class view organizes students and classroom quiz activity.
The grading workspace gives teachers a dedicated view for reviewing student work.
The student dashboard provides a starting point for learning and classroom activity.
The quiz view gives students a focused space to answer questions.
Built-in messaging supports communication between teachers and students.

projects.title: Decision-Driven Project Management Support System
projects.description: A centralized workspace for understanding projects and planning the next step. Dashboard summaries, project insights, client records, a shared calendar, and process history bring key information together for day-to-day decisions.

images.caption: The Evortix interface introduces the project management workspace.
The dashboard brings client totals, project trends, release updates, and upcoming schedules into one view.
Project insights provide a dedicated space to review project information and support planning.
A calendar view organizes schedules and upcoming project activities.
The client list keeps customer records accessible alongside project work.
Process history provides a reference for reviewing previous project activity.
A dedicated sign-in screen provides access to the workspace.

projects.title: Harvee
projects.description: A farm-to-door marketplace connecting customers, farmers, and delivery drivers. Customers can browse produce, manage delivery addresses, and check out, while dedicated farmer and driver workspaces support products, orders, and delivery activity.

images.caption: Harvee introduces its farm-to-door service with produce search and entry points for customers, farmers, and drivers.
The browsing experience helps customers explore available produce.
The customer dashboard brings shopping and account activity together.
The checkout screen guides customers through placing an order.
Address management keeps delivery destinations organized.
The farmer dashboard provides an overview of marketplace activity.
Product management gives farmers a dedicated space for their listings.
Order management helps farmers review and handle incoming customer orders.
The driver dashboard provides a dedicated workspace for delivery activity.
